evidence: SEM measurements were performed using a Jeol 6700FM SEM high-resolution field emission scanning electron microscope (JEOL Ltd., Tokyo, Japan), applying a 1-20 keV accelerating voltage. The ellipsometric model was validated by a profilometer (Veeco Dektak 8, New York, USA). Film thicknesses smaller than 5 nm were estimated using the linear dependency of the film thickness on the film growth per cycle (GPC). SERS measurements were carried out using a confocal Raman microscope (WITec GmbH, Ulm, Germany), equipped with a 488 nm excitation laser line. The SERS substrates were incubated in the riboflavin stock solution for 30 min and dried under a stream of air. The contact angle measurement of the non-metalized composite nanostructure (135 PE-ALD cycles) and the 50 nm silver metallized composite nanostructure depicted in Figure 5(b) was investigated.
